ur_kin.h:90: // @param q_sols  An 8x6 array of doubles returned, all angles should be in [0,2*PI)
ur_kin.cpp:6: double s1 = sin(*q), c1 = cos(*q); q++;   (lines 6-11 pass each joint value to sin()/cos())

notes: Both cited locations exist and their excerpts are accurate. Neither states a unit for joint values: ur_kin.h:90 documents only the range of q_sols returned by inverse() as [0,2*PI); ur_kin.cpp:6-11 passes joint values to sin()/cos(). Reading radians is an inference (2*PI interval; C trig arguments are radians), not a unit stated at the cited locations; no different unit is stated either, hence unverifiable rather than wrong.
